title: Construct bounded linear-work Clifford prefix keys; no speedup
body:
## Summary

Construct a bounded iterative index for exact Clifford prefix states. It reduces cold prefix-key preparation to O(LG), preserves exact Gaussian states, and removes the length-dependent recursion stack. This is a scoped algorithmic proof with finite corroboration and a negative complete-component timing experiment, with no new kappa.

```diff
- state key: (dimension, complete circuit prefix, basis)
+ prefix node: (parent ID, one frozen gate)
+ state key: (prefix ID, basis)
```

Neither tested variant demonstrates a speedup of the complete current native component. Both five-pair experiments and the first candidate's exact source are retained; no unfavorable sample was removed. The proposed contribution is the bounded construction, key-work proof and negative timing evidence, not a faster current-native replacement.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman's PR6479 prefix evaluator and the unchanged Charles Bethin, Wentao Li, Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Erwan L., Rohan Arun and native/P104 lineage. Prefix interning and LRU caches are classical methods. No predecessor theorem is audited or claimed anew.

## Evidence

- **Before:** a cold length-L request visits complete-prefix keys containing L(L+1)/2 gate occurrences and copies L(L-1)/2 slice references. At an explicitly imposed recursion limit of 256, the retained cold evaluator raises RecursionError on a 512-gate fixture.
- **After:** L+1 compact prefix nodes, O(LG) key preparation and exact completion of that fixture at the same stack budget. The written proof covers valid retained gates, one through nine address bits, at most 512 gates, mutable circuits between serial calls, node eviction and coordinated ID rollover. This does not claim failure at the default interpreter recursion limit.
- Normal and optimized conformance pass with identical receipts: 1,580 complete state comparisons, 257 cold key-count requests, mutation/eviction/rollover controls, five boundary rejections and source corruption rejection. All 2,941 native maps, 208 main adapters and 1,124 helper normalizers remain, including absolute phases and the existing wrong-phase rejection. The full native recipe hash is `4649372e3e86cee6f427df503fc64c32a7e3ae5ebb2b6e7302cb86521656dba9`.
- Every one of the 20 benchmark processes succeeds and reproduces the same full receipt. Baseline/candidate medians are 7.251/7.337 seconds without path retention and 7.153/7.592 with it. Ranges overlap, so no runtime improvement or universal slowdown is established. The package retains all runs, source hashes, host/load details and a separate diagnostic profile.

## Reproduce

From the repository root, using the local CPython 3.12 interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-prefix-key-index
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/clifford-prefix-key-index/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/clifford-prefix-key-index/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/clifford-prefix-key-index/check_depth.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/clifford-prefix-key-index/check_depth.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clifford-prefix-key-index --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace that interpreter. All four registered commands pass locally, each under eight seconds. Metadata/pins, committed bytes/modes, full declared source history and official export integrity/input coverage pass. Read-only exported checks also pass; the optimized export check uses an empty PATH. The nine retained functional inputs are authenticated package-local bytes from exact PR6479 head `ca129c9e0b12e2315765aab4c39c42220f68016d`; replay needs no pending Git object or network. The source-history check authenticates declared main provenance, not external scientific acceptance.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Extra interner/path storage is charged as real memory; no lower total-memory or measured runtime claim is made. Gate validity and serial calls are hypotheses. The proof uses the stated key-operation cost model and version-pinned CPython cost references. Finite checks corroborate the written proof and do not enumerate every circuit.

Physical native realization, full caller/compiler admission, ownership, precision/tape, stock, analytic recovery, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human review and formal proof-kernel review remain unrun or unclaimed. The selected frontier and five framework assumptions are unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Identify a measured prefix-length/miss-rate regime where compact keys improve the complete bill after preparation and extra storage. The current timings do not justify another index variation.
- Profile a larger unchanged native cost and propose a different algorithm that retains the same full receipt. No further target is reserved here.

## Related open work

- [PR6479](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6479) supplies the sparse-prefix baseline and independent Gray-order native tables. This adds compact key preparation; its claimed earlier speedup is credited, not recounted. Our required component runs compute the same 2,941-map receipt.
- [PR6453](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6453) supplies the exact current native word used here and its separate conditional supplier claim. This package preserves its 2,941-map native component and makes no claim about its kappa, full caller or compiler.

The completion refresh inspected all sixteen account open PRs created since the advance claim, including this PR. None of the other fifteen studies compact Clifford prefix keys or this exact 2,941-map native component. PR6492 and PR6486 concern the distinct D8 and dirty-phase consumers; no common timing or arithmetic count is compared. No extra scientific computations checked another contribution.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/clifford-prefix-key-index)`, passed at exact head `fa64749b9a069cd18292bea991636a78bc07b7f7` in [run 41557124701](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41557124701). The completed checks were read once. Separate run metadata confirms this head, completed status and successful conclusion. The replay executes all four registered normal/optimized conformance and depth checks.

All four registered commands, package replay, committed-byte/mode/source-history checks, official export integrity and read-only exported checks also passed locally. CI certifies execution of the registered finite checks and source bindings. It does not remeasure the local timing experiments or independently accept the written proof. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed. No failed or waived check remains.

Coordination: [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363376), [scope update and negative finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19363578).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

One new opt-in package. Shared tooling, predecessor files, selected-frontier records and supplier admission are unchanged.
